items.title: 'Endangered' parrot eggs hatch after two arrested in wildlife smuggling crackdown
items.standfirst: Two people have been arrested in South Africa for allegedly attempting to smuggle parrot eggs out of the country.
items.content: Two people have been arrested in South Africa for allegedly attempting to smuggle parrot eggs out of the country.

items.title: South African police arrest two Thai men for allegedly smuggling parrot eggs
items.standfirst: Bird eggs intercepted in homemade incubators at Johannesburg airport as officials try to halt wildlife traffickingSouth African police have arrested two Thai nationals in separate incidents for allegedly attempting to smuggle endangered parrot eggs out of the country as authorities try to stem the tide of wildlife trafficking.A 50-year-old Thai national was arrested at OR Tambo international airport in Johannesburg on 20 August, carrying 50 bird eggs in a homemade incubator in a hand-luggage bag, South Africa’s environment ministry said in a statement.
